questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead. Be ready to slow down or stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead has many curves and turns. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means slow down or stop. The left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing downward. You can use this instead of or along with your turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you see this sign. Let any trains pass before you cross. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending soon. You need to move to the left lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles at this location. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, this hand signal tells the group of riders to come to a stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a full stop and let vehicles and pedestrians pass. Only go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay on the side shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm out with palm facing down and swings it down, this hand signal tells the group to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Be prepared for vehicles joining the main road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: The shoulder ahead is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop completely before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended straight out means the operator is turning left or changing lanes to the left.
